title: x402 Signer Recovery Verifier
description: Recovers the ECDSA signer address from a caller-supplied EIP-712 digest and signature in (r,s,v) or (r,s,yParity) form. Normalizes the recovery-id across the raw bit (0/1), legacy Ethereum v (27/28), and EIP-155 v (chainId*2+35/36) conventions, each a well-known transcription trap. Reports the recovered address plus a separate boolean comparison against any caller-claimed from address (never silently failing when no claim is supplied). Signature recovery comes from the already-vendored, pinned noble-curves bundle (@noble/curves secp256k1 Signature.recoverPublicKey); malformed or invalid-recovery-id signatures produce a clean INDETERMINATE/RECOVERY_FAILED finding, never a thrown exception. Proves that an address's private key signed the exact digest supplied; does not prove settlement, spend, that funds moved, or that the authorization was ever submitted on-chain. Zero network calls; never a facilitator, proxy, gateway, or settlement relay.

digest.description: The 32-byte EIP-712 digest to recover a signer against (e.g. the art-590-x402-eip712-digest-recomputer output). Mandatory.

signature.description: Full signature hex: 64 bytes (r||s, recovery id supplied separately via v/yParity) or 65 bytes (r||s||v, recovery marker embedded). Alternative to r/s.

r.description: 32-byte hex signature r value. Used with s when signature is not supplied.

s.description: 32-byte hex signature s value. Used with r when signature is not supplied.

v.description: Recovery marker: raw bit (0/1), legacy Ethereum (27/28), or EIP-155 (chainId*2+35/36). EIP-155 form requires chainId.

yParity.description: Recovery marker as a raw bit (0/1). Takes precedence over v/embedded signature byte if supplied.

chainId.description: Required only when v is an EIP-155 value, to decode it back to the recovery bit.

claimedFrom.description: Optional 20-byte hex address to compare the recovered signer against. Omit for a standalone recovery-only call.

mcp_tool_definition.name: verify_x402_signer_recovery
mcp_tool_definition.description: Recovers the ECDSA signer address from an EIP-712 digest and a signature (r,s,v or r,s,yParity, with v/EIP-155 normalization), and compares it against an optional claimed from address. No hand-rolled crypto; recovery via the vendored, pinned noble-curves bundle. Malformed signatures produce a structured refusal, never a thrown error. No settlement or spend claim.

output_example.scope_note: Recovers the ECDSA signer address from a caller-supplied EIP-712 digest and signature. Proves that a given address's private key produced a valid signature over the exact digest bytes supplied -- it does not prove the recovered address is who the payload claims signed it (beyond the recovered_signer_matches_claimed_from comparison this node itself performs), that funds moved, that a transfer settled, or that the authorization was ever submitted on-chain. An authorization is not a settlement. Zero network calls; never a facilitator, proxy, or settlement relay.
